evidence.observation: Pressure at 2.948 Torr, matching the ramp plateau of about 2.92 Torr
Pressure rose steadily to 3.223 Torr (about +0.07 Torr per event) while Ar held at setpoint
MFC reads 100.7 sccm, close to the 100 sccm setpoint, so extra inflow does not explain the rise
O2 stays at 4-7 ppm, so there is no sign of air getting in through a seal leak
Temperature steady at 750 °C with normal heater power, so the thermal side is fine

args.missing_evidence: No reference distribution was given for growth-stage pressure. Checking the exhaust line, throttle valve and pump (or seeing whether pressure keeps rising) would confirm a blockage and rule out a normal process-related rise.
